narr: A long lived, organized complex of thunderstorms moved into central and southern Mississippi during the afternoon producing numerous reports of wind damage.
ev: MS Highway 16 was flooded between Mollett Rd and Sunny Lane Rd.
The southbound lanes of US 49 were flooded near Big Mound Road.
